title: Luminous Speech Experiment Receipt
description: Reproducibility contract for ASR, code-switch, semantic speech, adaptation and historical-language benchmark experiments. Schema validation checks structure, not truth, rights, execution or scientific validity.

candidate_selection.description: Optional closed-set ASR candidate-selection / MICL receipt. If this is present, it records the exact candidate pool and selector configuration. Candidate-selection output must be a candidate ID or ABSTAIN; a free-form rewrite is a separate experiment.

phonological_evaluation.description: Optional language-profiled FER/TER scoring configuration. Feature inventories and G2P are caller-governed; this receipt records what was actually used.

acoustic_faithfulness.description: Optional controlled audio/text/prompt conflict evaluation receipt. This does not authorize real-speaker identity or sensitive attribute inference.

counterfactual_pairs.description: Optional paired causal evaluation receipt. Distinguishes text nuisance invariance, audio-relevant evidence sensitivity and acoustic nuisance robustness.
